text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa! The people up ahead have a crazy 
amount of luggage! Are you two okay~?

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Carrying furniture all by yourself is 
reckless after all. Even if you are an 
Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, totally fine! It makes me happy 
when you rely on me. We divide up roles 
based on what we're good at, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...Then I'll navigate the easiest route 
for you! Let's take this path, there are 
fewer steps!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...Aww, they have such a nice vibe! It 
makes me want to cheer them on!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! I totally get it~! Hey, 
shouldn't we go give them a hand?!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for helping us! You must 
be thirsty, so please, have some carrot 
juice!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't have to~! Thanks a 
bunch, though!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Also, take this... as a thank-you. Tail 
shampoo sheets manufactured by our 
company. Please feel free to use them!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...! Right, tails get dirty easily. So 
that's how you care for it...!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What are you jotting down in your 
notes~?

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... The truth is, until I met her, 
I'd never had an Umamusume in my everyday 
life.

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
So I've been studying all sorts of things 
to keep in mind when living together. 
—Because I want to make her happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snuggle*)

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
...! Her tail, she just rested her tail 
against his leg~...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
She did...! Emotional distance: 0 miles! 
Closeness: 100 miles!

text_block_list.name: Blast & Gran
text_block_list.text: Wheeeeee~! Kyaaaaaa~!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah, an advertising truck... It's pretty 
loud. Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
He's covering her ears for her...! 
Kindness level: 80 miles!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
He knows that Umamusume have sensitive 
ears...! Nnnngh, full marks for 
thoughtfulness~...!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
...What a great couple. It really warms my 
heart~.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Seeing them care so much for one 
another rates at a full 1,000 miles!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Totally~! They've completely bridged the 
gap between humans and Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
...Must be nice. There are so many things 
that Bu wants to do for a person I get 
close to, too~...

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Going for a stroll♪ Going for a stroll♪ 
Alright, hop on my back! Hold on tight, 
okay~?

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Zoooom! Hehe, scared? Not at all, right? 
Isn't the view great~? Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That sounds amazing...! I'd want to show 
them the scenery seen by the strongest 
miler, too!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text: And then, and then...!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Welcome home~! It was cold outside, wasn't 
it! Whoa, you're shivering all over~!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Big hug~~~~. Ehehe, nice and warm, right? 
Bu is super toasty~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Blast-senpai. If you're that close—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ears. Our ears. Having them cleaned, or 
massaged...!

text_block_list.name: Blast & Gran
text_block_list.text: ...Kyaaaaa~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the cafeteria where I came for a 
break, my eyes meet with the two excitedly 
hyping each other up.
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll find someone great!
Please, don't mind me, carry on...

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yeah, yeah! I really hope so~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Blast-senpai! Another idea just came to 
me...—

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text: Ooh... yeah, yeah! Wait, hyahhh~!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Since you overheard us anyway, you gotta 
join in! How does it seem from a human's 
perspective?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, I was roped into their 
conversation and spent the rest of the 
time discussing humans and Umamusume.
